posts.title: Zipp 2001 Part 4: The Build Starts
posts.description: It’s finally time to start building up the Zipp! Before assembly I had to figure out how to stuff a 1 1/8" disc fork into a frame with a 1" head tube. The steerer does actually fit, but there isn’t much clearance. I turned some custom thin-walled headset cups out of 7075 to adapt the head tube and clear the steerer by a fraction of a millimeter. posts.title: Painted Zipp
posts.description: I finished applying all the layers of paint, sparkles, and clearcoat to the Zipp 2001 frame a couple months ago, and finally worked up the motivation to sand and polish the clearcoat. I did 2 coats of dark grey base coat, 2 coats of the Keirin flake topcoat, and probably 5+ coats of the clear topcoat so I’d have enough meat to sand down the high spots and polish without hitting the sparkles
